  UPDATE employees SET sales_count = sales_count + 1 WHERE id =
    (SELECT sales_person FROM accounts WHERE name = 'Acme Corporation')
    RETURNING *
)
INSERT INTO employees_log SELECT *, current_timestamp FROM upd;

                        (identifier))))

                        (identifier))
                      (operator)
                      (string)))))))
          (returning_clause
            (all_columns)))))

    VALUES (5, 'Gizmo Transglobal'), (6, 'Associated Computing, Inc')
    ON CONFLICT (did) DO UPDATE SET dname = EXCLUDED.dname;

        (string)))

        (index_element
          (identifier)))

          (identifier)
          (column_reference

================================================================================
Merge
================================================================================

MERGE INTO customer_account ca
USING recent_transactions t
ON t.customer_id = ca.customer_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN
  UPDATE SET balance = balance + transaction_value
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
  INSERT (customer_id, balance)
  VALUES (t.customer_id, t.transaction_value);

---

(source_file
  (merge_statement
    (table_reference
      (object_reference
        (identifier))
      (identifier))
    (table_reference
      (object_reference
        (identifier))
      (identifier))
    (binary_expression
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (operator)
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))
    (merge_when_clause
      (merge_update
        (set_clause
          (assignment
            (identifier)
            (binary_expression
              (column_reference
                (identifier))
              (operator)
              (column_reference
                (identifier)))))))
    (merge_when_clause
      (merge_insert
        (column_list
          (identifier)
          (identifier))
        (value_list
          (column_reference
            (identifier)
            (identifier))
          (column_reference
            (identifier)
            (identifier)))))))

================================================================================
Merge with every action
================================================================================

WITH s AS (SELECT * FROM src)
MERGE INTO wines w
USING (SELECT * FROM s) AS s
ON s.winename = w.winename
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET AND s.stock_delta > 0 THEN
  INSERT VALUES(s.winename, s.stock_delta)
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
  INSERT DEFAULT VALUES
WHEN MATCHED AND w.stock + s.stock_delta > 0 THEN
  UPDATE SET stock = w.stock + s.stock_delta
WHEN MATCHED THEN
  DELETE
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN
  DO NOTHING
RETURNING merge_action(), w.*;

---

(source_file
  (merge_statement
    (with_clause
      (cte
        (identifier)
        (select
          (all_columns)
          (from_clause
            (table_reference
              (object_reference
                (identifier)))))))
    (table_reference
      (object_reference
        (identifier))
      (identifier))
    (derived_table
      (subquery
        (select
          (all_columns)
          (from_clause
            (table_reference
              (object_reference
                (identifier))))))
      (identifier))
    (binary_expression
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (operator)
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))
    (merge_when_clause
      (binary_expression
        (column_reference
          (identifier)
          (identifier))
        (operator)
        (number))
      (merge_insert
        (value_list
          (column_reference
            (identifier)
            (identifier))
          (column_reference
            (identifier)
            (identifier)))))
    (merge_when_clause
      (merge_insert))
    (merge_when_clause
      (binary_expression
        (binary_expression
          (column_reference
            (identifier)
            (identifier))
          (operator)
          (column_reference
            (identifier)
            (identifier)))
        (operator)
        (number))
      (merge_update
        (set_clause
          (assignment
            (identifier)
            (binary_expression
              (column_reference
                (identifier)
                (identifier))
              (operator)
              (column_reference
                (identifier)
                (identifier)))))))
    (merge_when_clause
      (merge_delete))
    (merge_when_clause)
    (returning_clause
      (function_call
        (identifier)
        (arguments))
      (all_columns
        (identifier)))))
